_about: Hand-authored editorial layer for the Garden Retreat supplier gallery PROTOTYPE (pass2/supplier-galleries). Holds ONLY wording PlotNua writes about a maker, the evidence behind each location line, and an optional choice of image AMONG A MAKER'S ALREADY APPROVED ASSETS (the builder refuses anything else). Makers, product counts, websites, alt text, dimensions and credits come from the live Garden Retreat explorer config and image-rights-records.json. Headings live in discovery-headings.json. Location is shown only when evidenced and authorised for public display; UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN.
selectionNote: Makers appear in this gallery when they have licensed their imagery to PlotNua. The order changes on every visit, and inclusion is not a recommendation.
gridNote: Every maker in this Discovery, A to Z. Makers that have not licensed imagery to PlotNua are listed without pictures.
